about_the_game:
“Run. Don’t stop. Don’t think. Survive.”

You awaken in darkness. Your memories fractured. Your name… forgotten.

All that remains is The Voice—cold, mechanical, always watching. It tells you this is a trial. That you volunteered. That you must survive to remember who you are.

But you don’t recall volunteering. And you don’t know what waits at the end.

Game Features:

  • Narrative-Driven Platforming
    Navigate precision-based obstacle courses with only your instincts—and the cryptic voice in your head—to guide you.

  • Psychological Sci-Fi Mystery
    As you progress, the story unfolds dynamically through immersive voiceovers. Piece together your past, but beware: some truths should stay buried.

  • Enhanced Movement System
    Wield the powers of your experimental survival suit:

    • Double Jump (20s cooldown)

    • Grappling Hook (20s cooldown)
      Master them, or fall endlessly.

  • Immersive Atmosphere
    Stylized visuals, haunting sound design, and eerie voice-overs create an atmosphere of constant tension.

  • Diegetic Storytelling
    No cutscenes. No text dumps. Just voices, memories, and questions echoing in your ears as you climb, fall, and rise again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (or any 4+ core, 3.0+ GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB (DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 (6–8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A sci-fi first-person parkour survival game where every fall forces you to start again. Master your kinetic suit’s double jump and grappling tether as you navigate shifting platforms, obey cryptic AI commands, and uncover the truth. Will you survive long enough to remember why you’re here?
